Commentary.Commentary: 185 is the target now! Nigeria will have to bat out of their skins to chase this one down. The wicket is a little slow but still a good one to bat on but the Jersey players will be confident they can defend this one. Stay tuned for the chase in a while.

A power-packed batting display by Jersey! However, their batters were also helped by some horrible bowling by the Nigerians. They were all over the place to begin and were taken to the cleaners. A few of the Jersey batters should be disappointed with themselves as they did manage to get a start but could not make use of it. Greenwood and Jenner though did play well as their partnership has probably taken the score to one which one believes is way above par.
A couple to end! 14 from the last over. JERSEY END WITH 184/4! The last ball is a full one on middle, it is hit down to long on for two.
Also, Okpe is taken out of the attack as he had been warned before for bowling high full tosses. Chima Akachukwu will bowl the last ball of the innings.
NO BALL AND SIX! It was such a good over till then, this spoils it completely. A high full toss on off, Ward powers it over the long on fence. He just cleared it.
A full toss outside off, this is dragged through mid-wicket. They take one and go for the second. Complete it.
A dot! Slower one outside off, Ward swings but misses.
Outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
One more single! Outside off, this is slapped through covers.
A single to start the last over as this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket.
Okpe to bowl the last over.
OUT! BOWLED! Good length delivery on middle, Greenwood looks to play a scoop shot but misses it and gets bowled. Jersey were going for quick runs and that was the reason behind that shot.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Nick Greenwood. Short of a length delivery, Greenwood pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Length delivery on off, Greenwood plays a reverse scoop over third man for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Greenwood comes down the track and lofts it over covers. The batsmen get two runs.
Full delivery on middle, Greenwood drives it through mid on. The batsmen get two runs.
On a length on middle, Jenner lofts it over mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Vincent Adewoye is back into the attack.
One more single to end as this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Takes a few steps forward but mistimes his shot towards long off for one.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
FOUR! Slapped! Uses his feet, stays leg side of the ball and powers it through covers for a boundary.
Looks to play the paddle but the ball is too wide outside off. The batter drags it through square leg for one.
Chima Akachukwu is back into the attack. 2-0-19-0 his figures so far.
A single to end another good over for Jersey. This is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven through covers for one.
Fifty for Jenner, it has been a fine innings. Unlike his partners, he made use of the start and now would look to end the innings strongly. He gets there by hitting this one down to long off for one.
A full toss but Jenner was already in the position to play the reverse sweep. He misses to get hit on the pads.
SIX! Going, going gone! Full and on off, Jenner clears his front leg and hammers it over the mid-wicket fence.
Uses his feet and then hits the ball through covers for one.
On a length on off, Jenner plays a reverse sweep towards point. The batsmen get two runs.
Full delivery on off, Greenwood drives it to long off for a run.
On a length on off, Jenner punches it towards point for a single.
Short and outside off, Greenwood cuts it through point for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full delivery on middle, Greenwood lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
DROPPED! Length delivery on middle, Jenner looks to pull but gets a top edge. Adewoye himself goes for the catch, gets both hands to it but spills it. In the process, the batsmen take a single.
Vincent Adewoye is back into the attack.
A single to end the over! Full and wide outside off, it is hit through point for one.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They manage to come back for the second.
A low full toss now, Greenwood works it through mid-wicket for one.
A high full toss, almost another no ball but not given this time. The batter mistimes it towards cover for one.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Isaac Okpe is back into the attack. 2-0-19-1 his figures so far.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. So a good comeback after going for a biggie on the first ball, three singles after that.
A single as this is worked with the turn through square leg.
An appeal but not given! The batter steps outside the line of the off pole and looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side, a leg bye is taken.
Very full and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Fired on the pads, Jenner looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
SIX! That is out of here! What a strike that is. A huge hit that. This is fired on off, Jenner goes down on one knee and plays the slog sweep. Nails it over the mid-wicket fence.
Daniel Ajekun is back into the attack. 2-0-8-1 his figures so far.
One more couple! This is full and wide outside off, it is carved wide of the diving point fielder for two. 11 from this over.
Well plaved again! Uses his feet this time as he steps down the track, gets to the pitch and hits it wide of long off again. Calls for two and gets two.
FOUR! Nicely placed! This is a low full toss on off, Greenwood leans into it and places it wide of long off for a boundary.
Good running! The reverse sweep but it is towards short third man. The batters take a quick run.
One more short ball on off, this is hit through point for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped towards cover for one. A misfield means an easy single.
Full delivery on middle, Jenner drives it to long on for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Jenner flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on middle, Greenwood drives it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Greenwood drives it towards cover-point. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, Jenner pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Greenwood drives it through mid on for a run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shorter and outside off, inside the tramline. The batter looks to cut but misses again.
Way too wide outside off, Greenwood looks to cut but misses.
Very full and on off, the batter fails to jam it out.
Fires it outside off, this is hit crisply through covers for another run.
Flatter and around off, it is driven through covers for one.
Nick Greenwood is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front. Another batter walks back after getting off to a start. Stevens looks to play the sweep which he has done quite well so far. The ball though is too full on middle. He fails to get bat on ball and is hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger.
Full and outside off, it is jammed out to mid off. 14 from the over. One more huge one.
SIX! Nailed! That was right in the zone for Jenner. It is full and around off. He drags it over the long on fence for a biggie. It sounded good and it is the perfect result too.
Stevens makes room and the bowler follows him. He works it through mid-wicket for one.
Just the single from the Free Hit. It is very full, difficult to get under those. It is jammed out towards deep square leg for one.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! Third one in the game! The batter comes down the track and the bowler bowls a high full toss. Stevens swings but it goes off the outside edge down towards third man for one.
FOUR! Another reverse sweep! He loves that shot, doesn't he? Stevens plays it really well this time, right off the middle and over the short third man fielder. Boundary.
Stevens comes down the track but the bowler bowls a yorker. It is jammed out.
A single to end a good first by the spinner. Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Very full and on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
Looks to play the reverse sweep but getting his pad out of the line of the off pole. Misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but it is turned down.
Shorter and quicker again on middle, it is worked through square leg for two.
Fires it on the pads, the batter looks to paddle sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Flatter and outside off, it is left alone.
Spin for the first time. Daniel Ajekun is into the attack.
Another reverse lap from Stevens! This time it is not right off the middle but gets it over the keeper for two.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A full toss but the batter fails to take full toll of it. He hits it hard but straight to covers.
Outside off, it is once again slapped towards covers. This time in the gap for a run.
Another delivery outside off, it is hit to covers again.
Outside off, it is hit to covers.
On a length on middle, Stevens flicks it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Stevens looks to flick but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Jenner plays it towards mid on for a single.
On a length on off, Stevens plays it towards covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on off, Jenner drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and outside off, Jenner cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Stevens slaps it through covers for a run.

A couple to end the Powerplay! Loads of runs in it but the two wickets too. However, Jersey will be the happier of the two sides. They are 57 for 2. The last ball is a full one outside off, it is hit through covers for a couple.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
Jonty Jenner is the new man in.

OUT! Straight to the man! Picking wickets is probably the only way the run flow can be stopped and Nigeria have to do exactly that. The bowling change has worked. This one is full and on off, very full actually. Carlyon looks to go over mid off but does not quite get under the delivery. He hits it flat to mid off where Onwuzulike takes an easy catch.
A couple! Full and outside off, the batter hits it through the off side. Not off the middle but enough to get two.
A yorker outside off, it is jammed out to mid off.
Shortish and outside off, the batter throws his bat at it but misses.
Abiodun Abioye to bowl the last over of the Powerplay.
Just short! Looks to play the reverse sweep again but this time it brushes the gloves and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Innovation at its best now. A length ball outside off, Stevens plays a reverse paddle scoop. He does it excellently and it goes over the short third man fielder.
FOUR! Good improvisation. He makes room and the bowler bowls it short and outside off, it is slapped through cover-point and another boundary results.
Shorter and around off, this is cut towards point for one.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Chima Akachukwu is into the attack.
Back of a length and on off, the batter stands tall and punches it to covers. Back-to-back good overs for Nigeria.
A slower one around off, it is guided to point.

A direct hit and the batter was a goner! This is full and on off, it is powered towards mid off. The fielder fumbles and hence, the batter go for a run. They hesitate but still continue. The fielder picks the ball up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
The physio is out in the middle and the fielder is taking a breather and rightly so. He now seems fine and is all set to continue.

Dropped and the fielder is hurt! Maybe on the face. The ball must have burst through his hands. A short ball on middle, the batter pulls it towards square leg. It goes straight to him who tries to take it with two hands but the ball bursts through and hits him on the face.
On the fuller side, it is crisply driven but to the man at mid off.
Full on off, Stevens drives it towards mid off for a run.
WIDE! Bowls a length ball wide outside off, Stevens looks to play at it but lets it go.
A low full toss, not easy to hit those. The batter plays it towards mid on.

Top, top fielding! Three runs though off the Free Hit. Stevens innovates and brings out the reverse sweep. He hits it over short third man who hares after it and at the very end, dives forward and manages to pull it back in.
Free Hit time!

Another no ball! This time it is a high full toss. Maybe going for another yorker but this time the ball slips out. Stevens looks to pull but takes his eyes off and mistimes it back towards the bowler. Another Free Hit coming up.
Okpe seems to have got his line here. He bowls another yorker on off, it is jammed out.
Ben Stevens is the new batsman in.

OUT! KABOOM! Two top deliveries in a row, one just missed the stumps and the other knocks the off pole over. Okpe is delighted. Ferraby, who was dealing in boundaries is out of here. A much-needed wicket for Nigeria. This should lift them a little. Ferraby comes down the track and Okpe bowls it very full. NF ends up yorking himself. Fails to jam it out and the off pole goes for a walk.

FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Jersey won't care though. Ferraby comes down the track but this is a rare good delivery. It is on off and it jags back in. Ferraby looks to defend but gets an inside edge down to the fine leg fence.
For once, a delivery does not go to the fence. One more full toss outside off, the batter hits it hard but straight to the fielder at covers.

This could have been another boundary. Good fielding! The batter hits it straight down the ground. The fielder from long on runs to his right, dives and saves two. Another huge over, Jersey are off to an absolute flier.
FOUR! This is rubbish bowling! Another full toss on the body and with no fielder in the deep, it is always a boundary. Carlyon swings and gets it off the middle through mid-wicket.
FOUR! This is just poor, poor bowling! A full toss on the pads, Carlyon says thank you very much as he works it through square leg.
SIX! Takes full toll off the Free Hit. This is right in the zone, full and on off, Carlyon lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! Cardinal sin for any bowler in the shorter format as the next ball is a Free Hit. The bowler has overstepped. This is down the leg side, the batter swings but misses.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.

FOUR! It is raining boundaries here! Two in the last over and one to start this one. Short and outside off, Ferraby waits for it and then guides it past the short third man fielder for one more boundary.
Vincent Adewoye to bowl from the other end.
A single to end an expensive first over! This is fuller on off, it is stroked towards mid off for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! On the shorter side and with no fielder in the deep on the leg side, it is a Free Hit. Ferraby pulls it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! That has been swatted! First boundary in the over. This is one more length ball on off, this is slightly shorter and on middle, Ferraby picks the length early and hammers it over mid-wicket.
Another one on a length and around off, it is once again pushed to covers.
On the off this time and on a length, Ferraby pushes it to covers.
Excellent fielding to begin but poor ball there to start off! Short and wide. Ferraby cuts it through backward point. The fielder at third man runs to his right, dives and saves two for his side.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Nigeria players are out in the middle. Nick Ferraby and Harrison Carlyon will open the batting for Jersey. Isaac Okpe will start the proceedings for Nigeria.

PITCH REPORT - Niall O'Brien says the boundaries here are big and it will be hard to come by so running between the wickets is going to be important. Dirk Nannes says it is not one a bowler would want to bowl on but it is a touch dry so the spinners might get some turn. Slower balls is the way to go and 150 should be a good score.

Nigeria skipper Ademola Onikoyi says they wanted to bat too, it is their first time on this wicket and they want to do well. States they would want their players to step up to this occasion and make most of the opportunity they have got.

Jersey skipper, Charles Perchard says it looks a good wicket and he hopes to get a good score and he wants to put the opposition under pressure. States they have played here already and they have an idea about the dimension of the grounds and they are looking to carry forward their momentum.

Nigeria (Playing XI) - Daniel Ajekun, Leke Oyede, Sesan Adedeji, Vincent Adewoye, Isaac Okpe, Ademola Onikoyi (C/WK), Chimezie Onwuzulike, Sulaimon Runsewe, Daniel Gim, Chima Akachukwu, Abiodun Abioye.

Jersey (Playing XI) - Nick Ferraby, Harrison Carlyon, Ben Stevens, Jonty Jenner, Nick Greenwood, Benjamin Ward, Dominic Blampied, Anthony Hawkins-Kay, Jake Dunford (WK), Charles Perchard (C), Elliot Miles.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Jersey. Jersey have won the toss and have elected to bat.

Another game of this year's Men's T20 World Cup qualifiers and it is a clash between Jersey and Nigeria. It is a big moment for the latter as for many it is a surprise they made it till here. However, not a lot is expected out of them so they can play with the utmost freedom and you never know, they might just pull off a few upsets. They are up against a side in good form and are also favorites to win this game. However, this could be a tight contest. Stay tuned for the toss and teams in a while.
